metadata.source_note: Minimal contract to open a local-only COUNTERS -> COUNTERS_MATTER bridge without parser expansion, runtime counters engine, or cross-card closure.

scope_alignment.note: v1 intentionally stays narrow and does not model generic passive having-counters semantics.

bridge_kind.label: counters -> counters_matter
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable narrow local closure where explicit counter signals co-exist with explicit local counters-matter payoff wording.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only inside the same local card/profile.

required_local_signals: Profile produces at least one explicit local payoff action
activation_predicate.text_evidence_policy: Require explicit counters wording with counters-matter local phrasing (for each / one or more / whenever counters...) and explicit local payoff wording.
honesty_constraints: Do not infer global counter state.
Do not fire on generic counter mentions without explicit local payoff pattern.

implementation_shape_expected.helper_style: Dedicated local helper, inserted in existing local bridge block.

non_goals: Counter math beyond local bridge signal
